note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. ONS Local Planning Authority to Local Authority District (December 2024) lookup provides authoritative LAD24CD/LAD24NM and LPA24CD/LPA24NM relationships. This materially changes source method from the round23 names/codes register to an official cross-geography lookup. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA/LAD code or name, local-plan-boundary reference, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any lookup row would therefore be guessing. No coverage-area geometry can be bound to the slot; no source-area or parcel record accepted and no Plan0 package emitted.
